title: IMUI Table Header Owner Split v1
problem: EWG-070 identified `ecosystem/fret-ui-kit/src/imui/table_controls.rs` as the next high-payoff private owner split: editor-grade tables already have stable identity, sortable headers, context-menu hooks, and resize handles, but the implementation still mixed header trigger and resize behavior into the table body renderer. This lane moves table header behavior behind a private owner module without changing public IMUI names or runtime contracts.

repro.summary: Run the focused IMUI table smoke and interaction gates proving sortable/plain header and resize behavior stay unchanged after the private owner split.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-kit --features imui --test imui_table_smoke table_sortable_header_api_compiles table_resizable_column_api_compiles --no-fail-fast

gates.name: ui-kit-table-smoke
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-kit --features imui --test imui_table_smoke table_sortable_header_api_compiles table_resizable_column_api_compiles --no-fail-fast

continue_policy.notes: This lane is closed for the private table header owner split. Do not reopen it for public table APIs, table engines, sizing persistence, or runtime table semantics; start a new owner-split follow-on only with fresh proof pressure.
